prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 12 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1276; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes, with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headaches consistent with a whiplash mechanism of injury. The mechanism described is a plausible cause of the reported symptoms. Over the course of care, the patient attended twelve visits, which is somewhat longer than typical for this type of injury, reflecting a gradual but steady response to conservative management including manual therapy, stretching, and a home exercise program. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the presence of a cervical soft tissue injury. There is no record of prior injury or treatment involving the same body region. Billing records reflect single entries for each service rendered, with no repeated charges for the same procedures. At discharge, the patient had improved in range of motion and pain levels, though some residual stiffness remained, and a continued home exercise regimen was recommended.
